title: PROPHESY INTO YOUR DAY BEFORE 6AM | MORNING DECLARATIONS THAT SHIFT THINGS | APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
paragraphs: Lift your hands to the God who never sleeps, the God who was already awake before your alarm went off, the God who was watching over you through the night and he has brought you to this moment on purpose. Father, we receive you. We receive your word. We receive the fire of this hour. Let every ear that is connected to this word right now become a portal of divine encounter in the name of Jesus. Somebody shout hallelujah. I want you to do something before we go further. Share this message. Share it right now.

Don't wait until after. Share it now because you do not know who among your contacts is hanging by a thread this morning. You do not know whose life is about to be turned around by a single word from God. God may be choosing you as the instrument not because you are a preacher, but because you were obedient enough to pass it on. Share this word. You could be the reason someone's morning shifts. You could be the reason someone's week changes.

You could be the reason someone who was about to give up decides to pray instead. Share it. Now, sit down. Settle in. This is not a casual morning devotion. This is a divine interruption. God has called this moment for a specific reason and I want to tell you from the outset what you are about to hear, receive, and pray is going to alter the trajectory of your day. And when your day changes, your week changes.

When your week changes, your month changes and before you know it you are standing in a different season entirely. The title of what we are ministering today is this: Prophesy into your day before 6:00 a. m. Morning declarations that shift things. I need you to hear that again. Prophesy into your day before 6:00 a. m. Now, let me build this from the ground. Turn in your spirit, not even your Bible yet, just your spirit to the book of Job chapter 38 verse 12.

God is speaking to Job out of the whirlwind and he asked a question that I believe is one of the most loaded questions in all of scripture. He says, "Has thou commanded the morning since thy days and caused the day spring to know his place?" Commanded the morning. God is asking Job, "Have you taken dominion over the morning? Have you given the morning its assignment? Have you told the dawn where to go and what to do?" Now, understand what God is doing here. He's not mocking Job.

He's revealing to Job the technology of dominion that had been available to man all along. The morning has a place. The morning has an assignment. The morning has a gate. And the question is who is standing at that gate. Go now to Psalm 5:3. David, a man who understood warfare, a man who understood what it meant to have enemies both physical and spiritual. A man who had walked through deep valleys and yet climbed back into the presence of God. David says this, "My voice shall thou hear in the morning, oh Lord.

In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up." Direct my prayer. The word direct in the original text carries the idea of laying something in order, like a soldier who arranges his weapons before battle. Before the day begins, before the enemy has had a chance to set his agenda, before the chaos of the world comes flooding in. David was already in position. This is what I want to teach you today. The morning is a battlefield. It is not just the beginning of a new day.

It is the opening of a gate. And whoever goes through that gate first goes through it with authority. Listen carefully. There is a spiritual reality that most believers have never been taught. Every day has a morning watch. The morning watch is that window between the hours of approximately 4:00 a. m. and 6:00 a. m.

where the spiritual atmosphere is thin, where the activity of darkness that operated through the night is transitioning, and where whoever prays in that window literally sets the spiritual temperature for the events of that day. I am not teaching mysticism. I am teaching scripture. When Jesus healed the man with the withered hand, he healed him on the Sabbath morning. When Jesus rose from the dead, he rose in the morning. When the disciples received their great catch of fish, it was in the morning.

When manna fell in the wilderness, it fell in the morning. When the pillar of fire led Israel, they moved in the morning. Watch. The morning is not just a time of day. The morning is a spiritual appointment. And what you do with that appointment determines what the day does with you. There are dimensions to this I need you to understand. Dimension one, the morning is when decisions made in the spirit realm are executed in the natural. Let me explain this carefully. Principalities and powers operate on systems.

The kingdom of darkness is not random. It is structured. Just as there is a hierarchy in the kingdom of God, God, Christ, angels, saints, there is a hierarchy in the kingdom of darkness. And those systems release assignments. Those assignments are assigned to days, and the execution of those assignments begins at the opening of the morning. This is why warfare prayer before dawn is so powerful. When you pray before the day opens, you are intercepting assignments before they can be carried out.

You are essentially standing at the gate before the enemy's messengers arrive. Dimension two, your words in the morning are seeds. Everything you say in the early hours of the day lands in freshly turned spiritual soil. The atmosphere in the morning is uncontaminated by the noise and activity of the day. When you open your mouth in the morning and you decree the word of God, those words carry unusual weight. They go deep. They produce quickly.

This is why Proverbs 8:17 says, "Those that seek me early shall find me." Early, the Hebrew word is shahar, which means to seek diligently at the breaking of dawn. There is a reward attached to early seeking. There is a dimension of God that is accessible specifically in the morning that is harder to access in the afternoon. Dimension three, your day has already been written, but you can add your voice to it. Now, this is deep, so follow me. God is omniscient. He knows the end from the beginning.

He knows what this day holds, but God has also given man dominion. He has given man the authority to speak, decree, declare, and establish. So, while God knows what the day holds, your declarations in the morning do not fight against God's sovereignty. They align with it. They are the mechanism by which God's will for your life gets executed on the earth. Ezekiel 37, God shows the prophet a valley of dry bones. God does not raise those bones himself without a human voice.

He tells Ezekiel, "Prophesy onto these bones." The resurrection was in God's will, but God needed a voice on the earth to release it. This is the pattern. Heaven acts when earth declares. And your morning declarations are your invitation for heaven to invade your day. Write this down. Your silence in the morning is not neutral.

When you wake up and say nothing, when you pick up your phone and scroll before you pray, when you allow the morning to sleep past without your voice being raised, you are not in a neutral position. You have handed the keys of your day to whoever else wants to speak over it, and I promise you, the enemy has something to say. He has been speaking all night. Are you going to let him have the first word? Romans 4:17, God, and this is who we are called to imitate.

God called those things which be not as though they were. This is not fantasy. This is not the law of attraction. This is apostolic faith operating through sanctified speech. God spoke the world into existence. He said, let there be light, and there was light. He did not say, I hope there will be light. He did not say, I believe in my heart that there could potentially be light. He spoke with authority, with conviction, with finality, and it was done. You are made in his image.

You carry that same creative capacity. When you open your mouth in the morning and declare, this is the day the Lord has made, you are not reciting a song. You are establishing a spiritual reality. When you declare, I am the head and not the tail, you are not boosting your self-esteem. You are releasing angels to enforce what you have declared. Hebrews 1:14 says, angels are ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation. They are sent. They are on assignment.

But, the question is, what assignment? Psalm 103:20 says, angels hearken onto the voice of his word. They respond to God's word, and when you speak God's word over your life, you give your angels something to work with. Your silence starves your angels. Your declarations feed them. Let me go further. Job 22:28, Eliphaz, in spite of being ultimately corrected by God for other things, makes a statement of profound spiritual principle.

He says, thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established onto thee, and the light shall shine upon thy ways. Decree a thing, establish it, and light comes. What is that light? In the context of this verse, light means clarity. Light means favor. Light means the removal of confusion and the entrance of divine direction. When you decree in the morning, your path becomes illuminated. You stop stumbling through your day. You stop making decisions in the dark. Light comes to your ways.

This is why David could say in Psalm 23:1, "The Lord is my shepherd, I shall not want." This was not just a song. This was a morning decree. David was establishing the reality of his day. He was declaring who was leading him before he took a single step. And because he declared it, the shepherd showed up to lead. Are you tracking with me? Now, let me preach to you for a moment. The reason many believers are frustrated is not because God is not willing. It is not because the promises are not real.

It is not because they lack faith. It is because they have abdicated the morning. They wake up reactive instead of prophetic. They wake up and immediately enter the stream of the day's demands. Emails, news, WhatsApp messages, children, traffic, and before they know it, the day has them. Not they having the day, the day has them. A reactive Christian is a defeated Christian. Not because God abandoned them, but because they vacated their post. Listen carefully.

When a soldier abandons his post, the enemy does not wait for him to come back before advancing. The enemy advances. And now the soldier is fighting to reclaim territory he never should have lost. Every morning you fail to pray is territory the enemy claims. And now instead of advancing, you spend your day trying to recover, trying to undo what was done because you were not at your post. This is not condemnation. This is revelation. There is a difference.

I decree that from this morning, you will never again give the enemy the advantage of the morning. From this day, you will rise before the sun demands your attention. You will rise before the world makes its claims on you, and you will declare the word of God over your day, your family, your finances, your health, and your destiny. Turn with me to Isaiah 62:6-7. I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night. Ye that make mention of the Lord, keep not silence.

And give him no rest till he establish, until he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth. This is God commanding intercession. God saying, "Keep not silence. Give me no rest. Keep bringing the matter before me." This is the posture of the morning prayer warrior. Not someone who casually mentions God in passing. Not someone who prays for 5 minutes while making breakfast. Someone who stands on the wall. Someone who takes their position seriously.

Someone who says, "I will not be silent until I see the promise established." And when you pray like that, heaven moves. I decree and declare right now in the name of Jesus that the spirit of slumber that has kept you from your morning altar is broken. That pattern of sleeping through the most powerful hours of the day, that spirit is cast out now. I speak to your sleep in the name of Jesus. I decree divine insomnia for the kingdom, where God wakes you up at 4:00 a. m. , at 3:00 a. m. , at 5:00 a. m.

, and instead of fighting it, you rise and you pray, and in that secret place, he meets you with fire. Let me shift into the prayer now. This is where we move. Everybody, let us rise. If you are able to rise physically, rise. If If are listening while driving, keep your eyes on the road, but open your mouth. If you are in your room alone, do not be ashamed. Raise your voice. Heaven hears your voice. Hell hears your voice. Your morning hears your voice. Let us enter the courts of heaven. Father, we thank you.

We thank you for the privilege of this moment. We thank you that you are a God who hears prayer. We thank you that your ears are open to the cry of your people. Father, we thank you for this morning. We thank you that we are alive. We thank you that the enemy could not stop this moment. We thank you that every plot against this day has already failed. We worship you, Father. We exalt you. We lift your name high. You are the ancient of days. You are the God who inhabits eternity. You are the Lord of hosts.

You are El Shaddai, God Almighty. You are Jehovah Nissi, our banner in the day of battle. You are Jehovah Rapha, the God who heals. You are Jehovah Jireh, our provider. We worship you. We honor you. We give you the glory that is due your name. Now, let us begin to pray. The first thing I want you to do is declare over yourself. Open your mouth and say, "I am alive today by the will of God. My life is not an accident. My morning is not an accident. I have been preserved to fulfill destiny.

The enemy does not have authority over my day. This day belongs to God and to me. I walk in covenant. I walk in the blood of Jesus. I walk in the authority of the Holy Spirit. My morning is blessed. My day is blessed. My going out is blessed and my coming in is blessed. From this moment forward, I prophesy life into my day." Say that like you mean it. Say it again. Now, let us go to war.

Father, in the name of Jesus, we take authority over every assignment of darkness that was released against the people of God during the night. Every spirit that operated while men slept, we arrest it now. Every python that wrapped itself around destinies overnight, loose your hold now in the name of Jesus. We command every strangling spirit to release God's people this morning. The grip of the enemy is broken in the name of Jesus. We declare freedom.

Every leviathan spirit, that spirit of pride and twisted thinking that makes people believe the lie of the enemy rather than the truth of God, we bind you now. We cast you down. You have no authority over the minds of God's people. In the name of Jesus, the minds of God's children are clear. The minds of God's children are sharp. The minds of God's children are aligned with the word of God. Father, we stand in the gap for every person who did not wake up to pray this morning.

For everyone whose morning started in crisis, in panic, in anxiety, we cover them now. Let the blood of Jesus create a hedge of protection around them. Let the angels of God be dispatched to their homes, their workplaces, their vehicles, their environments. No weapon formed against them shall prosper. No tongue raised against them in judgment shall prevail. In the name of Jesus. Now someone pray this prayer. Pray it with authority. Every altar that was constructed against my destiny overnight, I pull it down now.

By the fire of the Holy Ghost, I dismantle every dark altar. I break every sacrifice offered on my behalf by agents of darkness. I scatter every gathering of witches, warlocks, and principalities that convened through the night to discuss my downfall. The Lord rebuke you. The Lord scatter you. The blood of Jesus is against you. Pray that. Now begin to thank God. Begin to worship. Release that sound. You are worthy, Lord. You are worthy. Worthy is the lamb.

You are worthy of all the glory, all the honor, all the praise. From the rising of the sun to the going down of the same, your name is to be praised. Now, stay in that place for a moment. I want to speak to someone. You have been in a season of what I can only describe as divine silence. You have prayed, you have fasted, you have waited, and you have heard nothing. No voice, no sign, no open door, nothing. And the enemy has been whispering to you that God has forgotten you.

I want to tell you this morning the silence is not abandonment. The silence is preparation. In the natural world, before an earthquake, there is a deep stillness. Before a storm, there is a calm. Before a sunrise, there is the deepest darkness. What you have been experiencing is not the end, it is the before. Habakkuk 2:3 says, "For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak and not lie. Though it tarry, wait for it, because it will surely come. It will not tarry.

The promise is on its way. It has not been canceled. It has not been revised. It has not been reassigned to someone else. It is yours, and it is coming." I decree over that person the silence is broken. This morning God begins to speak to you again. This morning clarity comes. This morning the cloud lifts. This morning what was hidden is revealed. What was lost is found. What was delayed is released. In the name of Jesus. Let us continue to pray.

Father, I bring before you every family represented under the sound of this word. Every home, every marriage, every child, every parent. I declare that this morning the covenant of God covers every household. Every home that has been experiencing strife and discord, let the peace of God invade that home now. Let the spirit of division be cast out. Let unity come. Let love come. Let the presence of God become the atmosphere of every home represented in this prayer.

Every marriage that has been under attack, I decree life into that marriage now. The enemy has no authority over a covenant sanctioned by God. That marriage is not over. That relationship is not finished. God is not done with it. In the name of Jesus, I decree restoration. I decree healing. I decree a fresh start. I decree that the love of God, which was shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Spirit, fills every room of that marriage right now.

Father, for every man who has been struggling to provide, the man who wakes up every morning with the weight of financial pressure on his chest, the man who feels inadequate, who feels like he's failing, who has been applying for positions and getting rejected, who has been believing for business and watching it struggle, Father, I speak to that man right now. You are not a failure. You are not forgotten. The hand of God is upon you, and your miracle is already in motion. I decree open doors.

I decree divine connections. I decree the right people who carry the keys to your next level will find you today. I decree that the grace for provision rest upon you like a mantle in the name of Jesus. Let supply come. Let resources flow. Let the windows of heaven open over every man who has been carrying this burden in silence.

And to the woman, the woman who has been holding everything together while quietly falling apart inside, the woman who smiles for everyone else but weeps when she's alone, the woman who is tired, not lazy, but genuinely, deeply tired, I speak rest to your spirit right now. I speak the strength of Jehovah into you. God sees your sacrifice. God sees your faithfulness. God sees the tears you cry at night when no one is watching and he says to you, "I have seen your tears. I will reward you openly."

For every body in womb under the sound of this voice, every woman who has been told by doctors that she cannot carry a child, every woman whose hope has been deferred so many times, that hope itself has become painful, I decree into your body right now. I speak to your womb. I speak to your reproductive system. I speak to every hormonal imbalance, every structural blockage, every spiritual embargo against conception. In the name of Jesus, I command it to break. You are Yahweh.

You are the God who opened Sarah's womb when she was 90 years old. You are the God who opened Hannah's womb when the priesthood had given up on her. You are the God who said to Elizabeth, "Your reproach is taken away." You do not change. You are the same God. And what you did for them, you can do for my sister right now. Father, visit her womb. Visit her body. Give her the child she has been believing for in Jesus' name. Someone under the sound of my voice, there is a pregnancy that you were told would not survive.

The doctors gave a negative report. I decree life into that pregnancy. I decree that child shall live and not die. I decree that delivery shall be safe. I decree that child will come forth whole, healthy, and carrying the glory of God. In the name of Jesus. Now, let us shift to deliverance. I want to deal with something that many people are embarrassed to bring before God, but I will not let it pass.

There are people under the sound of this word who are bound by things they cannot explain, addictions they have prayed about and still cannot break free from. Patterns of behavior that keep repeating the same relationship mistakes, the same financial cycles, the the emotional traps over and over again, and they have condemned themselves so many times they have almost stopped believing in change. I want you to hear me. What you are experiencing has a name, and its name is a covenant.

At some point, whether by your own hand or through your bloodline, a covenant was established with darkness. And that covenant is producing fruit in your life. But I have good news, covenants can be broken. Galatians 3:30 says, "Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us." The cross broke every covenant. The cross dismantled every legal right of darkness over your life. And when you come into alignment with what the cross accomplished, chains fall off.

Father, right now in the name of Jesus, I break every generational covenant over the people of God, every covenant made by ancestors who did not know you, every covenant made by parents in ignorance or rebellion. Every covenant sealed by blood sacrifice, by occult initiation, by sexual immorality, by idol worship, by land transactions involving dark powers, I break them all now. The blood of Jesus speaks better things. The blood of Jesus dissolves the ink of every dark covenant. In the name of Jesus, you are free.

Receive your freedom. Don't just acknowledge it intellectually. Receive it in your body, in your emotions, in your will. Say, "I receive my freedom. Every chain is broken. Every cage is open. I walk out of this. I walk out." In the name of Jesus, let us deal with witchcraft. I know this makes some people uncomfortable, but I will not stop preaching the full gospel because it makes someone uncomfortable. Witchcraft is real. Familiar spirits are real. Monitoring spirits are real.

And there are people under the sound of this word, who have been under consistent witchcraft attack, attacks that come through dreams, through unexplainable accidents, through stagnation that makes no logical sense, through repeated failures on the threshold of breakthrough. Nahum 3:4, the mistress of witchcrafts that selleth nations through her harlots and families through her witchcrafts. Nations, families, this is not a small thing. Witchcraft has a reach, but God is greater.

In the name of Jesus, every witchcraft projection sent against the destinies represented in this prayer, I return it to sender right now. Every arrow of the enemy released in the night season, I arrest it in the name of Jesus. Every monitoring spirit assigned to spy on your progress and report back to the enemy, your assignment is terminated. I bind I cast you out. I command you to leave and not return.

In the name of Jesus, every dream where you were eating that was not a natural dream, that was a spiritual transaction. I break the effect of every evil spiritual transaction made while you slept. Everything that was deposited into your body through a dream of eating, of drinking, of sexual contact, I command it out of your body right now. Come out in the name of Jesus. Come out. Come out. Begin to pray it personally. Every deposit of darkness in my body, come out now.

Every sickness, every disease, every terminal condition introduced through a spiritual door, come out in the name of Jesus. I am the temple of the Holy Spirit. No unclean thing has a right to dwell here. Come out now. Father, let the fire of the Holy Ghost purge every system in the bodies of your people. Let the blood of Jesus flush out every foreign substance. Let the angels of God minister healing to every organ, every cell, every tissue. I speak to cancer, you are not bigger than God.

Wherever cancer has been diagnosed in the breast, in the lungs, in the blood, in the bone, I speak to it now. DRY UP. DIE. Be eliminated from the body by the fire of the Holy Ghost. In the name of Jesus, receive your healing. I speak to high blood pressure, normalize now. I speak to diabetes, every out of control blood sugar level, come into order in the name of Jesus. I speak to every heart condition, every blockage in the arteries, every irregular rhythm, every weakened muscle of the heart, be healed now.

The God who created the heart knows how to fix the heart. Father, lay your hands on every heart condition and heal it completely. Someone under the sound of my voice has been dealing with consistent headaches and migraines. Doctors have found nothing, but it is a spiritual attack. There is a spirit of infirmity on the head. In the name of Jesus, I cast it out now. Lose your hold on this person's head. Lose it. And Father, fill that space with your peace.

Let the peace of God which passes all understanding garrison this person's mind and body. No more headaches, no more migraines in Jesus' name. Let us move into the area of finances and destiny. There is something called a financial embargo. It is when the enemy constructs a spiritual barrier around a person's financial life that prevents the full manifestation of their financial destiny. They work hard.

They have good ideas, they have skills, but somehow something always blocks the full expression of their increase. Money comes in and disappears. Business opportunities arrive, but collapse at the last minute. Promotions get delayed or given to someone else. I am here to tell you that embargo breaks this morning. Malachi 3:11 says, "And I will rebuke the devourer for your sake, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground." God himself rebukes the devourer.

God himself stands between you and the one who consumes your resources. This promise is yours, and I activate it over you now. In the name of Jesus, every financial embargo is lifted. I decree that every door that has been shut against your finances is open now. Every account that has been dry is replenished now. Every harvest that the enemy has been stealing is restored now sevenfold in the name of Jesus. Father, I pray for everyone who is in debt.

Every person carrying the crushing weight of financial debt, divine strategies for wealth come to them now. The mind of Joseph is upon them. The mind that sees solutions others cannot see. The mind that turns farming into fortune. Lord, give them the idea, the connection, the favor that breaks the cycle of debt and establishes a new financial reality. I decree that multiple streams of income open to the people of God. I decree that divine contracts are signed. I decree that the grace for wealth is activated.

I decree that no one under the sound of this voice will end this year in poverty in the name of Jesus. Let someone say my harvest shall not be consumed. My increase shall not be swallowed. The enemy will not dine on my labor. What God has ordained for my hands shall manifest in full in Jesus' name. Now, I want to speak to destinies. There are people under the sound of this word who are in the wrong location, not just physically, spiritually.

You are in a season or an environment that is not aligned with your divine assignment. You feel it. There is a dissonance between where you are and where you know you are supposed to be. You can see your assignment, it is like a picture in your spirit, but the gap between where you are and where you see yourself seems impossible. I want to tell you the dissonance you feel is not a sign that you are lost. It is evidence that the picture in your spirit is real. God-given visions create holy dissatisfaction.

They are designed to pull you toward your purpose. The gap is not permanent. The gap is a runway. You are being prepared for takeoff. Isaiah 43:19. Behold, I will do a new thing. Now it shall spring forth. Shall you not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert. God says in the wilderness, in the desert, in the place where nothing grows, in the place that makes no sense, that is exactly where he chooses to do the new thing. Your season is not wasted. Your pain is not wasted.

Your waiting is not wasted. God is doing something in the wilderness that could not have been done in the palace. There are things being formed in you in this season of pressure that prosperity could never produce. Character, depth, unshakable faith. And when you emerge from this wilderness, no storm will ever shake you again. I decree over you the new thing is springing forth. Even as you read these words, the new thing has already begun. The way in the wilderness is already being carved.

The river in the desert is already flowing underground, and you are about to see it with your eyes. Prophetic word. Someone under the sound of my voice has been offered an opportunity that they have been hesitant about because of fear, fear of failure, fear of what people will say, fear of the unknown. I want to tell you that door that you have been standing in front of hesitating, that is your door. Go through it. Take the step. God did not give you that opportunity to embarrass you.

He gave it to you because it is your time. The fear you feel is not a warning from God. It is a resistance from the enemy who knows what is on the other side of that door. You are entering your season of acceleration. What took others 10 years, God will do for you in two. What was stolen in a decade, God will restore in a moment. Acceleration is your portion. In the name of Jesus. There is someone else you have been writing.

You have been writing something a book, a business plan, a script, a proposal, and you have not finished it. You have been telling yourself you are not ready. You are not qualified. It needs more work. I want to tell you finish it. The imperfect finished thing in God's hands is more powerful than the perfect unfinished thing in your drawer. Finish it. Submit it. Release it. God will use it. Let us go back into prayer. Father, I bring before you every young person represented in this prayer.

Every student, every graduate, every young professional trying to find their footing. Every young person who has been told they are too young, too inexperienced, too unknown, Lord, I speak the grace of Joseph over them. The favor that cannot be explained. The grace that bypasses the queue. The divine recommendation that comes from heaven itself and introduces them to the right people at the right time.

Father, I pray that every young person under the sound of this word who has been suffering from identity confusion, who has been struggling to find their purpose, their voice, their place, Lord, let revelation come. Let the purpose for which they were born be unveiled to them with such clarity that they wake up every morning with direction. Give them the gift of knowing why they are here. I decree that no gift in the young people of God shall be buried. I decree that platforms arise. I decree that voices are heard.

I decree that doors open in unexpected ways. In the name of Jesus, the next generation of God's generals is rising and the enemy shall not be able to stop them. Let us deal with the spirit of death. I do not say this lightly, but I know because the spirit of God is present that there is someone under the sound of this word who has been visited by the spirit of death.

Either through a dream where you were at your own funeral or through a persistent thought that you are going to die young or to a medical diagnosis that has given you a timeline. I want to confront that spirit right now. Psalm 118:17 says, "I shall not die, but live and declare the works of the Lord." This is a prophetic decree. It is a declaration of war against premature death and I raise that same declaration over you now. In the name of Jesus, I break every assignment of premature death.

Every covenant with the grave made by a generational ancestral broken now. Every spirit of death masquerading as a medical condition, I rebuke you in the name of Jesus. The hand of God is upon this life. And until the purpose of God is complete, no one and nothing has the authority to terminate it. You will live. You will live. You will see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living. In Jesus' name. Begin to declare, "I shall not die, but live. I shall not die, but live. Death has no authority over me.

I am preserved for purpose. Every spirit of death is rebuked. The blood of Jesus covers me. The blood of Jesus protects me. The blood of Jesus preserves me. I am alive for a reason and I will fulfill every reason in Jesus' name. Now, let us speak about divine preservation for the week ahead. Every road you will travel this week, let the angels of God guard those roads. Every vehicle you will enter, let the angels of the Lord cover those vehicles. No accident, no road rage, violence. No sudden evil shall befall you.

In the name of Jesus, you are preserved, you and your household. Every environment you will enter this week, your workplace, your school, your business premises, the market, the field, let the atmosphere of God's favor go before you. Let the presence of God attend you everywhere you go. Let people notice something different about you and not be able to explain it. Let the favor of God create openings in places that had been shut. Let the grace of God speak for you when you are not in the room.

Psalm 91:11, "For he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways." Angelic assignment, angelic coverage, I activate it over you right now. Let the angels of God be on assignment on your behalf this week, ministering, protecting, clearing the path, fighting on your behalf in realms you cannot see. I decree that this week divine appointments take place. The person you meet on Monday is not an accident. The phone call you receive on Wednesday, answer it.
